title: Gradient
summary: Gradient and Laplacian of a scalar field.

methods.name: Partial derivatives
methods.reason: Everything here comes from the first and second partial derivatives.

steps.title: Take the partial derivatives
steps.text: Differentiate with respect to each variable in turn, holding the others fixed.

steps.title: Form the gradient
steps.text: The gradient points in the direction in which \(f\) increases fastest; its length is that fastest rate.

steps.title: Tangent plane
steps.text: The plane \(z = f(a,b) + f_x(a,b)(x-a) + f_y(a,b)(y-b)\) touches the surface \(z = f(x, y)\) at the point and is the best linear approximation near it.
